Vines and Mercurio conjure something rarer than illusion at the Broadway Comedy Club: they conjure shared joy.

cn.t: Critics rave about Broadway Magic Hour, with scores of 90-95/100. Vines & Mercurio's magic transcends age, conjuring genuine wonder that leaves sophisticated adults and children alike wide-eyed. A rare live experience delivering pure, shared joy.
